automodfetcher.confirm.title: This server needs different mods
automodfetcher.confirm.subtitle: %s will be downloaded into your mods folder
automodfetcher.confirm.manual.replaces: You have a file with this name, but it is a different build — replace it with the server's
automodfetcher.confirm.section.remove: Will be removed on the next launch (%s):
automodfetcher.blocked.file_name: The server sent an unsafe file name
automodfetcher.progress.title: Downloading mods
automodfetcher.complete.title: Mods updated
automodfetcher.complete.removed: %s mod(s) will be removed on the next launch
automodfetcher.complete.restart: Restart the game, then join the server again.
automodfetcher.confirm.connect_anyway_wa: If the server needs these, you may be disconnected right after joining.
automodfetcher.kicked.cause.packet: This is not a missing mod. The server sent something your mods could not read, which usually means a mod's CONFIG differs between the two sides — and configs are not synced.
automodfetcher.kicked.cause.mods: Your mod list and the server's do not match. This is what happens when you join without installing everything it offered.
automodfetcher.kicked.cause.registry: The server's list of blocks and items does not match yours. Usually one content mod is switched off or missing — interface mods do not cause this.
automodfetcher.kicked.cause.network: The connection dropped rather than the server refusing you. Nothing about your mods explains this one.
automodfetcher.kicked.title: Disconnected from the server
automodfetcher.kicked.missing: You are missing mods the server has:
automodfetcher.confirm.shared_install: These will load in all your other worlds too — give this server its own game directory.
automodfetcher.confirm.remember: Don't ask again for this server
automodfetcher.complete.incomplete: Some mods are still missing — try again, or go back and pick another server.
automodfetcher.host.sharing: AutoModFetcher: your %s mod(s) will be offered to anyone who joins this world.
automodfetcher.host.exclude_hint: To keep some of them to yourself, add the file names to excludeFileNames in %s.
automodfetcher.confirm.section.untrusted: This server uses a source outside Modrinth and CurseForge:
automodfetcher.confirm.untrusted_warning: Only continue if you trust whoever runs this server. Downloads may redirect to that site's own file host.
automodfetcher.confirm.section.bundle: %s file(s) will be unpacked from a bundle on %s:
automodfetcher.blocked.insecure: Sent over plain http, which cannot be trusted
automodfetcher.command.bundling: Packing the mods no platform carries...
automodfetcher.confirm.section.missing_d: Missing dependencies — these mods will not start (%s):
automodfetcher.confirm.missing_dependenc: Nobody can download these from the server. Ask the server owner to bundle them, or install them yourself before joining.
automodfetcher.confirm.section.reenable: You already have these, but they are switched off (%s):
automodfetcher.confirm.reenable_hint: They will be switched back on, not downloaded again. Your launcher turned them off.
automodfetcher.kicked.reenable: The server needs these %s mod(s) and they are switched off here — likely why you were dropped:
automodfetcher.confirm.bundle_also_publi: This mod is also published on a platform, but this copy is not from there.
automodfetcher.confirm.bundle_skip_hint: Click a file above to skip it. Skipped mods are not installed, and the server may refuse you without them.
automodfetcher.confirm.connect_anyway_hi: You can join without these. If the server needs one of them it will say so itself, and this screen will explain what it said.
automodfetcher.confirm.section.foreign: This server does not run these (%s):
automodfetcher.confirm.foreign_hint: They will be moved to %s, next to your mods folder. Nothing is deleted.
automodfetcher.complete.disabled: %s mod(s) will be moved out on the next launch
automodfetcher.restart.title: One more restart
automodfetcher.restart.body: Your mods folder is ready, but this session is still running the old ones.
automodfetcher.restart.why: Mods are only read at launch, so restart once more before joining.
automodfetcher.complete.close_to_finish: Close the game — the leftover mods are removed as it exits, then just reopen it.
automodfetcher.confirm.section.bundle_di: %s file(s) came with the server's reply:
automodfetcher.confirm.section.needed_by: Mods you already have will not load without these (%s):
automodfetcher.confirm.needed_by_local_h: Skip these and the game stops at the loading screen, naming a library rather than this choice.
